punchline: A thin pipe wall started a chain that reached the wing and fuselage of a plane with 469 aboard.
thirty_sec: On 4 November 2010 a Qantas A380 out of Singapore lost its No. 2 engine over Batam Island: a fatigue crack in an oil pipe, an oil fire, a separated turbine disc, debris into the wing and fuselage. It landed at Changi and none of the 469 aboard died.
question: If one part of your important work failed, could you list which parts would fail after it?
key_contrast: Not one failure but a chain of them.
